{{Short description|U.S. film award}} {{Infobox award | name = Actor Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture | awarded_for = Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Motion Picture | presenter = [[SAG-AFTRA]] | location = [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] | holder = ''[[Sinners (2025 film)|Sinners]]'' (2025) | website = {{URL|https://www.actorawards.org|actorawards.org}} }} The '''Actor Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast''' (or '''Ensemble''') '''in a Motion Picture''' (formerly '''Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture''') is an award given by the [[Screen Actors Guild]] to honor the finest acting achievements in film. It is the final award presented during the ceremony. ==Eligibility== In order for an individual actor to be eligible for an award as part of the cast, they must be credited with a single-card [[Billing (performing arts)|billing]] in the movie's main titles, although exceptions can be made at the discretion of the awards committee in cases of "special, unusual, or non-billing".{{Cite web |first=Steve|last=Pond|title=SAG ensemble rule rewards stars, shortchanges key actors |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/lifestyle/sag-ensemble-rule-rewards-stars-shortchanges-key-actors-idUSTRE7BG02Q/ |date=17 December 2011 |website=[[Reuters]]}}{{Cite web |first=Marcus James|last=Dixon|title=Why 'Avatar's' Jack Champion and 'The Pitt's' Shawn Hatosy are not eligible for ensemble noms at Actor Awards: See the film and TV submissions |url=https://www.goldderby.com/film/2025/actor-awards-jack-champion-shawn-hatosy-not-eligible-cast/ |date=11 December 2025 |website=[[Gold Derby]]}} ==Winners and nominees== :{{legend|#FAEB86|indicates the winners.}} ===1990s=== {| class="wikitable" width="100%" |- ! width="7%"| Year ! width="31%"| Film ! width="62%"| Cast members |- | rowspan="5" align="center"| 1995
